scientific_question: Does halving the remaining LR change closed-loop success within a paired resumed protocol, and is the observed single-versus-joint retention pattern robust to a new training seed? These are different questions.
evidence_limits: Joint midpoint12/20 versus final10/20 and selected init0/8 trajectory losses do not prove late-training degradation or its mechanism.
Single13/20 versus joint10/20, exact McNemar p0.375, does not establish gradient interference.
Tasks1..3 lack matched single-task positive baselines; task0-only contrasts do not establish all-task interference.

options.value: Within each checkpoint/task-count condition, only nominal LR differs; directly tests LR sensitivity under registered reset sampling.
options.limits: Not historical exact continuation, seed robustness, or causal gradient-interference proof.
options.decision: remain selected for implementation preflight, not execution

options.composition: one fresh single40k plus one fresh joint160k with matched per-task exposure
options.value: Tests whether the original task0 retention pattern replicates under another training seed, with half the rollout cost of the four-arm LR design.
options.limits: Does not manipulate LR; one extra seed still provides weak population-level evidence.
options.decision: explicit alternative retained for final budget decision

options.reason: Sampling reset confounding or no isolated falsifiable intervention.

decision: Do not infer launch readiness from accumulated narrow probes. Complete a single integrated bounded preflight before further component-only checks or any GPU budget activation; then choose between the two scientific questions explicitly.
